capabilities: Connect an Obsidian vault to other notebook tools via the SamePage protocol
Sync note changes across connected notebooks
extras: README warns the extensions are in beta, not stable for real or sensitive data, all data shared on SamePage is public, and probability of data loss is high; full docs are hosted elsewhere.
problem: Notes in Obsidian are isolated from other notebook apps, so changes and queries cannot span tools.
summary: Client for the SamePage protocol that connects an Obsidian vault to other note-taking tools to sync changes and run cross-notebook queries.
